parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the rule. The maximum length is 500 characters.

parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the data quality rule.

parameters.name: ErrorHandlers
parameters.description: The list of issue handlers for the data quality rule check.

sub_parameters.name: ErrorDataFilter
sub_parameters.description: For a custom SQL rule, you must specify an SQL statement to filter problematic data.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the DataWorks workspace.

parameters.name: SamplingConfig
parameters.description: The settings required for sample collection.

parameters.name: Severity
parameters.description:
The severity of the rule for the business (corresponding to the strong/weak rule on the page). Valid values:
- Normal
- High

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: The object monitored by the rule.

parameters.name: TemplateCode
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the rule template that the rule references.
